activities.name: Water Healing with Mayumi Yonamine
activities.description: In-Residence: through December 7 One&Only Spa Guided by renowned wellness practitioner Mayumi Yonamine, this immersive WATSU® hydrotherapy experience combines gentle stretches and therapeutic touch in warm water. Designed to reduce stress, improve mobility, and restore balance, Water Healing promotes deep relaxation and a renewed sense of well-being. Please contact your Host or Guest Experiences to book.

activities.name: Master of Podiatry, Bastien Gonzalez
activities.description: November 13-15 One&Only Spa Acclaimed podiatrist Bastien Gonzalez returns for three days of exclusive treatments at his PEDI:MANI:CURE studio. Performed in tandem with our resident specialists, the signature four- hand experience revives dull skin, alleviates aches, and restores vitality to your hands and feet. treatment) Please contact your Host or Guest Experiences to book.

activities.name: Rest & Restore with Gyde Von Wlassack
activities.description: In Residence: November 13 - December 4 One&Only Spa Restore balance and resilience with renowned German therapist Gyde von Wlassack. Combining advanced neurophysiology with osteopathic techniques, her transformative approach helps regulate the nervous system, guiding the body from stress and fatigue into a deeper state of rest, recovery, and renewal. Please contact your Host or Guest Experiences to book.

activities.name: Corazon Playero Pop Up
activities.description: Discover “Wearable Art” by Corazón Playero, one-of-a-kind, handcrafted hats and accessories made by local artisans. Visit our exclusive pop-up to explore the latest collection or design your own bespoke headware.

activities.name: The Arroyo Course
activities.description: Twisting its way through a calming desert landscape, this acclaimed ‘nine’, which can be looped for 18, winds past giant centuries-old cardón cacti, juxtaposed against the sweeping Sea of Cortez vistas below. The course is home to native quails, roadrunners, and hawks, along with formidable doglegs and lengthy forced carries, all which converge to create the most thrill-inducing Los Cabos. person Please contact your Host to learn more.

activities.name: Course Lesson
activities.description: 2-hour playing lesson (9 holes) Clinics require a minimum of 3 participants and are limited to 6 players. Reservations required 24 hours in advance. Cancellations made within 24-hours of start time are not refundable. Please contact your Host to learn more.

activities.name: Play with a Pro
activities.description: Palmilla Golf Club Designed for those who prefer to pair up rather than take a lesson, this unique experience offers the opportunity to discover the course through the eyes of an expert who knows every fairway, green, and hidden gem along the way. Subject to availability. Reservations required 24 hours in advance. Cancellations made within 24-hours of start time are not refundable. Equipment provided. Transportation from Porte Cochere departs 15 minutes prior to start time. Please contact your Host to learn more.

activities.name: Lux Open House: Tennis & Pickleball
activities.description: Palmilla Golf Club Discover the world of tennis and pickleball at One&Only Palmilla during a morning of active fun and exploration. Meet Christopher, our LUX Tennis Director, learn about tailored programs and private lessons, and discover activities for all ages and skill levels. An ideal introduction to Palmilla’s vibrant racquet sports community. Equipment provided. Transportation departs from Porte Cochere. To reserve, please contact palmilla@luxtennis.com or call +52 55 2114 5321.

activities.name: Entre Tacos
activities.description: Sala 56 Satiate your palette with an unlimited selection of gourmet tacos, salsas and garnishes. The mouthwatering experience is accentuated by the star-lit Baja skies paired with an acoustic musical performance and a selection of the best cocktails this side of the Sea of Cortez. Please contact your Host to learn more.

activities.name: Peninsula Nights
activities.description: Lucille’s Kitchen The rhythm of the night meets the flavors of Baja at Lucille’s Kitchen. Live music pairs perfectly with savory starters, premium cuts and the freshest Sea of Cortez flavors grilled to perfection and served family-style by Chef Carlos Grande, just as Lucille Bremmer did 70 years ago. Please contact your Host to learn more.

activities.name: Pelican Beach Cabanas
activities.description: Mediterranean-inspired beachfront cabanas at our swimmable beach featuring a curated mezze selection, Veuve Clicquot Brut Champagne, personalized service, and views of the Sea of Cortez for a refined seaside escape.
